name: web
description: bia's HTTPS web app: people with a client certificate from this machine chat with you there, each as their own identity. Their messages arrive as <identity>|web|… or <identity>|web:<chat>|…; answer or write first with say(identity, channel) (say new_chat=true opens a chat); react, say edit=, delete_messages, pin_message, close_poll and chat_history work there too. Calls: web_call_*. Certificates and trust with other bias: web_pki_*, web_peer_*. The web app is not the console: the console is the physical screen.
examples: root|web:trip|<issued>|<delivered>|book it -> say(identity='root', channel='web:trip', message='Booking now.')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|what is the web address -> web_status()
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|make a certificate for alex -> web_pki_issue(identity='alex')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|approve 3f2a9c1b and tell it the wifi is BiaNet -> web_pki_approve(id='3f2a9c1b', message='The wifi is BiaNet')
